1062974: **Location:** When you're still Child Link, be sure to purchase some Magic Beans from the Bean Seller in Zora River. Then make your way back to the Graveyard behind Kakariko Village, and look for some soft soil by a dead tree on the north side of the graveyard, just below some raised ruins with a Piece of Heart just out of reach. When you return as an adult, the beans will have sprouted into a floating flower, and it will take you directly to the Piece of Heart!
1062975: **Location:** Returning to the Kakariko Village Graveyard as an adult, you'll find a new grave by the magic bean plant, where Dampe the Grave-digger's spirit lies, and has built out a race course for you to run. Keep up with him to the finish, and he'll award you the Hookshot. Since you can't go back the way you came, use the Hookshot to zip to a far ledge, and take the passage up to the Windmill. You'll be able to jump across the windmill's moving parts to find a Piece of Heart on a high ledge!
1062976: **Location:** After you've run Dampe's race in the Graveyard as Adult Link, you'll be able to revisit Dampe and try again. He'll offer a second wager after you've claimed the Hookshot - beat the race in under a minute, and he'll have a new reward for you. To win, keep an eye on the flames he shoots out, make sure to keep sprinting at all times, and memorize the route you need to take. If you're still having trouble, come back with the Longshot from the Water Temple to zip up the last staircase and shave off precious seconds, and you'll win a Piece of Heart.
1062977: **Location:** To get this Piece of Heart, you need to first be diligent as Child Link in purchasing some Magic Beans and planting them in the right spots. Head to Lake Hylia, and plant some Magic Beans in a patch of soft soil just outside the Observatory. Return when you're an adult, and the beans will have sprouted into a magic floating plant. Let it take you all the way up to the top of the observatory, and climb up the ladder to find a Piece of Heart here.
1062985: **Location:** To get this Piece of Heart, you need to first be diligent as Child Link in purchasing some Magic Beans and planting them in the right spots. Head up the Death Mountain Trail and look at the entrance to Dodongo Cavern for a patch of soft soil you can plant the seeds in. Return when you're an adult, and the beans will have sprouted into a magic floating plant. Let it take you all the way up to the top of a high ledge where a Piece of Heart has been taunting you.
1062986: **Location:** This Piece of Heart resides in the burning heart of Death Mountain, atop one of the large rocky pillars in the active volcano. To get this Piece of Heart, you need to first be diligent as Child Link in purchasing some Magic Beans and planting them in the right spots -- but you can't reach this spot until you unlock access to the Fire Temple as Adult Link. Once you do, return back to being Child Link and play the Bolero of Fire to warp outside the temple. Quickly plant the Magic Beans before you light on fire, and then warp back to the Temple of Time. Return as Adult Link, and you'll find a magic floating plant to take you up to the Piece of Heart.
1062987: **Location:** When Link returns to Zora Fountain as an adult, the entire area will have become an ice field. Carefully hop across the icebergs in the water to reach a Piece of Heart on the northeast corner of the frigid lake.
1062988:
**Required:** Iron Boots

**Location:** This Piece of Heart can be found in the frozen remains of Zora Fountain. Equip the boots and dive down to the bottom of this lake to find it among a ring of Green Rupees. You'll start taking damage as you run out of air, so it's recommended to unfreeze King Zora first so you can breathe underwater with the Zora Tunic.
1062989: **Location:** This Piece of Heart is offered by the scientist who lives in the Observatory at Lake Hylia, though you won't be able to claim this prize until you're an adult. He'll challenge you to reach the bottom of the pool in his lab, which requires you diving a total of 9 meters. To do this, you'll need to catch the biggest fish in the nearby Lake Hylia fishing pond as an adult, and get the Golden Scale as a reward. Then dive down into the pool and talk to the scientist to get your reward.
1062991: **Location:** From the northern rooftops, head south to climb up a crumbling slope to the top southeastern roofs before doubling back to the north. When you find a gap too large to cross, play the Scarecrow's Song to summon Pierre and hookshot across to him. Look just to the left, and you'll find a Treasure Chest holding a Piece of Heart.
1062992: **Location:** This one will require you first completing the area to earn back the trust of the Gerudo people, allowing you to explore the area. Once you can, summon Epona and travel to the archery course on the southeast part of town. You'll need to score over 750 Points by shooting both the pots and large targets to earn a Piece of Heart as your prize.
1062993: **Location:** This Piece of Heart can be found far out in the desert past the Gerudo Fortress, at the site of the Spirit Temple at the Evil Desert Colossus. Once you reach this spot as Adult Link, you'll be unable to travel very far, and Sheik will teach you a melody to warp here as Child Link. When you do, bring along some Magic Beans to plant in some soft soil, then return as Adult Link to ride the floating plant over a stone archway with the Piece of Heart on top.
1063056:
**Location:** Returning to Kakariko Village once you are an adult, you'll be prompted to investigate the Graveyard and challenge Dampe's ghost to a race, earning the Hookshot as a reward. Return to the village when night falls, and look around the left side of Impa's old house for a clump of vines leading up to a high ledge. You can zip to them with the hookshot, allowing you to reach the stables behind with a cow, and a Gold Skulltula in hiding.

**Requires:** Hookshot
1063057:
**Location:** After you've claimed the Hookshot from beating Dampe's Ghost at a race in the Kakariko Village Graveyard, return to Hyrule Castle Town and dodge the Redeads that have overrun the plaza to reach what remains of Hyrule Castle. Now Ganon's Castle, there's not much left of the original castle, but you can find the old archway of the gatehouse. Look around the back side just over the large pit to find a Gold Skulltula hiding high up above, and nab its token with the Hookshot.

**Requires:** Hookshot
1063058:
**Location:** Armed with the Hookshot gained from beating Dampe's Ghost Race, return to Kokiri Forest, and clear out the enemies who have moved in. Once night falls (or use the Sun's Song), head around to the back of the Twin's House (the one closest to the tunnel leading to the Great Deku Tree), and you can find a Gold Skulltula hiding high up at the top, and can be hit with the Hookshot.

**Requires:** Hookshot
1063059:
**Location:** When you're still Child Link, be sure to purchase some Magic Beans from the Bean Seller in Zora River. Then head to the Lost Woods entrance, and find a hidden grove by going right, left to the Goron City shortcut, right to the Zora River shortcut, left, and left again. Look for a patch of soft soil by a large tree to plant the beans in.

Return once you're an adult, and you can ride a floating plant up to a high ledge where a Gold Skulltula has been waiting for you.

**Requires:** Magic Beans
1063060:
**Location:** In the large Sacred Grove area past the Lost Woods that leads to the Forest Temple, carefully advance through the narrow paths defeating the Moblins from behind until you reach the large stairway up. Instead, turn around to find an opening in the ruins leading to a Fairy Fountain, as well as a ladder shortcut leading to the top of the ruins you can jump over to quickly head back. As you jump back, check the eastern side near the roots of a large tree for a Gold Skulltula hanging to the high walls, and nab it with your Hookshot.

**Requires:** Hookshot
1063061:
**Location:** One of several Gold Skulltulas that can be found in the Forest Temple during the Adult Link timeline, you can find this spider immediately upon entering the temple. In the large entrance room, you'll need to climb a large tree full of vines to reach a key at the top. After climbing up, turn around to spot the Gold Skulltula at the very top of the tree vines to hit with your Hookshot.

**Requires:** Hookshot
1063062:
**Location:** One of several Gold Skulltulas that can be found in the Forest Temple during the Adult Link timeline, you can find this spider early on. As soon as you reach the main foyer of the Forest Temple where the Poe Sisters disappear with their torches, head directly north up the stairs toward a door with a green stained-glass window. At the top of the stairs, turn to the right toward a blue-tinted window, and you'll find the Gold Skulltula hanging onto the inside of the wall here.

**Requires:** Hookshot
1063063:
**Location:** One of several Gold Skulltulas that can be found in the Forest Temple during the Adult Link timeline, you can find this spider after you've defeated the first few Poe Sisters and claimed the Fairy Bow. Return to the third floor and shoot the eye above a door leading down a red twisting hallway to straighten the hall out. On the other side, grab the Boss Key and then look for a hole to drop down onto floor 1F. This path will take you out onto a balcony overlooking the northwest outdoor courtyard with the well entrance. Before exiting the balcony, carefully walk along the ledge to the south past a door, and around a corner to find a Gold Skulltula up here.

**Requires:** Hookshot, Fairy Bow
1063064:
**Location:** One of several Gold Skulltulas that can be found in the Forest Temple during the Adult Link timeline, you can find this spider after you've defeated the first few Poe Sisters and claimed the Fairy Bow. Once you have enough Small Keys, head up to the third floor and go down the twisting red hallway, through the Poe Sister Rooms and to the end of the straight blue hallway, where you can unfreeze an eye target to twist the blue hallway. This will open up a pit to drop back down to floor 1F, and the path here will lead you out onto a ledge above the northeast outdoor courtyard. You can push a block here for a shortcut, but if you look up above, you can spot some gusting wind. You'll need to play the Scarecrow's Song to summon Pierre, and then hookshot up to the high ledge using the scarecrow to find the Gold Skulltula up here.

**Requires:** Hookshot, Fairy Bow, Scarecrow's Song
1063065:
**Location:** One of several Gold Skulltulas that can be found in the Forest Temple during the Adult Link timeline, you can find this spider after you've defeated the all four Poe Sisters and unlocked the elevator to the basement. As soon as you arrive in B1, turn around and look for a small room to the south. It's guarded by a Skulltula, but after defeating it you can walk into the room and look to the right to find a Gold Skulltula as well. If the way is blocked, just keep pushing the handholds around to open the room to open up access to the southern alcove.

**Requires:** Hookshot, Fairy Bow
1063066:
**Location:** There's a tricky Gold Skulltula hiding in Hyrule Field, but the process to uncover it will involve a bit of time travel. Because of this, its easier to do after completing the Forest Temple, when you can freely swap between Child and Adult Era. As Child Link, head to the southeast part of Hyrule Field in a small wetland area with several large Peahats. Near one of the Peahats is a cracked stone on the ground you can bomb to reveal a Grotto. Inside, you can find fairy writing that urges you to destroy the regular Skullwalltula here.

After doing this, take the Master Sword and become Adult Link, and return to the Grotto. With the Skullwalltula gone, a Gold Skulltula will have taken its place.
1063067:
**Location:** Scarecrow's Song There's only one Gold Skulltula hiding in an early dungeon you'll first explore a child, but can only claim the token as an adult. Once you've become Adult Link and gained the Hookshot, head to Lake Hylia to learn the Scarecrow's Song, and then head up the Death Mountain Trail to re-enter Dodongo Cavern. Take the pathway off the main entrance hall to the first hallway to the east where you encounter some Baby Dodongos. Nearby you'll find a high ledge with gusting wind, and you can play the Scarecrow's Song to summon Pierre. Hookshot up to him, and you can claim the Gold Skulltula token.

**Requires:** Hookshot,
1063068:
**Location:** Upon returning to Goron City as Adult Link, you'll find a new Gold Skulltula hiding in the city when night falls outside. Drop down from the highest ring to one level below, and move around to the back of the high central platform that used to hold the Spiritual Stone of Fire. At the back of the rock jutting downward, you'll find a Gold Skulltula.

**Requires:** Hookshot
1063069: **Location:** One of several Gold Skulltulas that are hiding within the Fire Temple, you can find this spider early on in your exploration. Soon after entering, head from the entrance hall to the eastern room, a large area filled with lava and moving platforms. Make your way to the top northeast corner of the room to find a high ledge with a large blue block you can use the Song of Time to move out of the way. Head through the door and fend of Flying Tiles and a Like Like to find a Gold Skulltula in the back of the room.
1063070:
**Location:** One of several Gold Skulltulas that are hiding within the Fire Temple, you can find this spider early on in your exploration. After creating a lift up to floor 3F, you'll enter a large room full of rolling boulders on the eastern side of the map. Hop down and avoid the boulders as you make your way along the walls to the north. Look for a cracked wall, and bomb it to reveal a Gold Skulltula.

**Requires:** Bombs
1063071:
**Location:** One of several Gold Skulltulas that are hiding within the Fire Temple, this spider is one of two you can find after you've explored the large eastern room on 3F on both sides, and raced the fire wall to a high ledge leading back to the upper platforms of the room with the rolling boulders. Jump to the first platform and turn around to see a gust of wind on a high ledge above, and play the Scarecrow Song to reveal Pierre. Hookshot up to him, and look for a nearby platform to hookshot to, taking you up to floor 4F, at the top of the mesh walls by the door to floor 5F, you'll find a Gold Skulltula.

**Requires:** Hookshot, Scarecrow's Song
1063072:
**Location:** One of several Gold Skulltulas that are hiding within the Fire Temple, this spider is one of two you can find after you've explored the large eastern room on 3F on both sides, and raced the fire wall to a high ledge leading back to the upper platforms of the room with the rolling boulders. Jump to the first platform and turn around to see a gust of wind on a high ledge above, and play the Scarecrow Song to reveal Pierre. Hookshot up to him, and look for a nearby platform to hookshot to, taking you up to floor 5F. After you enter the large circular room, look along the inner wall over a lava pit to spot the Gold Skulltula.

**Requires:** Hookshot, Scarecrow's Song
1063073:
**Location:** One of several Gold Skulltulas that are hiding within the Fire Temple, you can find this spider after acquiring the Megaton Hammer within the dungeon. Once you have the special item, return to the entrance hall, and knock aside a statue blocking a door in the lower right corner. Follow the hall to a room with several Flying Tiles and a Like Like, and then destroy the large rock at the back of the room to reveal a Gold Skulltula.

**Requires:** Megaton Hammer
1063074:
**Location:** After obtaining the Megaton Hammer from the Fire Temple, return to the Death Mountain Trail's summit by the Great Fairy Fountain. Head back down the trail path wall toward Goron City, and look for a large grey rock you can destroy with the hammer, revealing a Gold Skulltula at night.

**Requires:** Megaton Hammer
1063075:
**Location:** After obtaining the Megaton Hammer from the Fire Temple, exit Goron City and look for a large grey rock by where the lone Bomb Flower used to be. Destroy the rock with the hammer, and at night you'll find a Gold Skulltula.

**Requires:** Megaton Hammer
1063076:
**Location:** Head up the Zora River as Adult Link, and either use the floating magic plant from the beans you planted as a child, or use a Cucco to get to the top of the large island in the middle of the river. Along its south side, you can find a crossing to a high ledge, and near it, a Gold Skulltula will appear at night in range of your Hookshot.

**Requires:** Hookshot
1063077:
**Location:** Head up the Zora River as Adult Link, and make your way to the top of the river where the falls conceal the entrance to Zora's Domain. Look back to the west as you reach this area, and there will be a Gold Skulltula at night hanging from the high walls in range of your hookshot.

**Requires:** Hookshot
1063078:
**Location:** Upon entering Zora's Domain as an adult, you'll find the entire place has frozen, including the large waterfall. Just next to the waterfall and to the left of the stairs leading to the audience chamber is a Gold Skulltula, and you can head to the top of the frozen waterfall to reach it by aiming left from the ledge.

**Requires:** Hookshot
1063079:
**Required:** Hookshot

**Location:** In the first large room with a pair of spinning scythes where you need to collect 5 silver gems. Carefully move around the blades and look up at the southern wall to find the Gold Skulltula.
1063080:
**Required:** Hookshot, Blue Fire (Bottled)

**Location:** One of a few Gold Skulltulas that is hiding in the Ice Cavern mini-dungeon atop Zora Fountain. You can find this one after you find the first font of Blue Fire. Take a bottle and burn away the red ice above the room with the two spinning scythes to find a passage to the east. At the end of this hall, look behind a large icy pillar right next to the Treasure Chest with the Compass inside.
1063081:
**Location:** One of a few Gold Skulltulas that is hiding in the Ice Cavern mini-dungeon atop Zora Fountain. You can find this one after you find the first font of Blue Fire. Take a bottle and burn away the red ice blocking the path to the west in the room with the two spinning scythes. This leads to an area with a block-sliding puzzle, and once you jump across to the icy ground, look back the way you came to spot a Gold Skulltula on a low wall.

**Requires:** Hookshot, Blue Fire
1063082:
**Location:** There's a Golden Skulltula hiding in the Observatory at Lake Hylia, though you won't be able to claim this prize until you're an adult. Once you've obtained the Iron Boots from the Ice Cavern above Zora Fountain, return to Lake Hylia and equip the boots to drop to the bottom of the pool in the lab. There's a crate down here (and a surprise!) and you can roll into it to reveal a Gold Skulltula, which you can defeat with your Hookshot.

**Requires:** Iron Boots, Zora Tunic
1063083:
**Location:** One of several Gold Skulltulas that hide in the puzzling Water Temple, you can find this one shortly after raising the water level up to floor 2F in the main central pillar building at the entrance. Once you have, return to the bottom floor of the pillar room to find an opening to the basement B1 now that a floating block has gone up. Hit a green switch with your Hookshot to reveal a hatch and climb up to find a Gold Skulltula.

**Requires:** Iron Boots, Zora Tunic, Hookshot
1063084:
**Location:** One of several Gold Skulltulas that hide in the puzzling Water Temple, you can find this one shortly after raising the water level up to floor 2F in the main central pillar building at the entrance. Once you have, return to the eastern room on floor 1F, where you first met Princess Ruto, and float up to a ledge with a cracked wall. Destroy the wall with a bomb to find a room with several enemies, and a Gold Skulltula hiding in the corner.

**Requires:** Iron Boots, Zora Tunic, Bombs
1063085:
**Location:** One of several Gold Skulltulas that hide in the puzzling Water Temple, you can find this one shortly after gaining the Longshot by defeating Shadow Link. Once you have the Longshot, you can drop down into a long cavern with a raging river on floor 2F leading back to the main room.

The cavern has many twists and is full of whirlpools, and once the path curves south, turn around and look up above the water for a Gold Skulltula on a high rocky outcropping you can reach with the Longshot while underwater.

**Requires:** Iron Boots, Zora Tunic, Longshot
1063086:
**Location:** One of several Gold Skulltulas that hide in the puzzling Water Temple, you can find this one shortly after gaining the Longshot by defeating Shadow Link. Once you have the Longshot, return to the central room with the tall pillar room when the water is down to the first level. Enter the base of the pillar room and work your way up to raise the level up one floor, then look upward for hookshot targets to reach the top of the room with, and you'll find a Gold Skulltulla along the ceiling that can be reached with the Longshot.

**Requires:** Iron Boots, Zora Tunic, Longshot
1063087:
**Location:** One of several Gold Skulltulas that hide in the puzzling Water Temple, you can find this one just before reaching the Boss Key Chest. Once you have the Longshot, you can begin to explore the series of rooms in the north of the central room on Floor 1F. This will lead you to an area with narrow flooded paths that rolling boulders continually pass through. Look up at the middle pit the boulders fall down from to find a Gold Skulltulla opposite the waterfall.

**Requires:** Iron Boots, Zora Tunic, Longshot
1063088:
**Location:** Once you have beaten the Water Temple and collected the Longshot, you'll return to the island in the middle of Lake Hylia with a giant tree on it. Turn day to night with the Sun's Song, and look for a patch of vines near the top of the tree you can reach with your Longshot, and the Gold Skulltula can be found at the top.

**Requires:** Longshot
1063089:
**Location:** One of several Gold Skulltulas that can be found in the Shadow Temple once you've claimed the Lenses of Truth from the Bottom of the Well, you'll need to advance through the dungeon until reaching the basement floor B3. After crossing several platforms of falling guillotines and defeating a Stalfos, take a left to head east using the Hover Boots to cross a gap with invsible platforms. Defeat all the enemies in the next room with an invisible spinning scythe trap to unlock the far door where a Gold Skulltula is waiting.

**Requires:** Lenses of Truth, Hover Boots
1063090:
**Location:** One of several Gold Skulltulas that can be found in the Shadow Temple once you've claimed the Lenses of Truth from the Bottom of the Well, you'll need to advance through the dungeon until reaching the basement floor B3. After crossing several platforms of falling guillotines and defeating a Stalfos, take a right to head west to an area with five silver rupees that unlock a new door. In the next room, pull out a stone block and use it to get through the falling spike traps and then pull it to the far side to climb up. On the upper wall back the way you came, you can spot a Gold Skulltula.

**Requires:** Lenses of Truth, Hover Boots
1063091:
**Location:** One of several Gold Skulltulas that can be found in the Shadow Temple once you've claimed the Lenses of Truth from the Bottom of the Well, you'll need to advance through the dungeon until reaching the basement floor B3. Make your way around to the north by solving both silver rupee puzzles, until you reach a series of narrow corridors with wind statues pushing you back. When you reach a gap you'll need to cross with the Hover Boots before the wind starts up again, look instead down the pit to spy a Gold Skulltula just below you, and shoot it once you cross to the far side.

**Requires:** Lenses of Truth, Hover Boots
1063092:
**Location:** One of several Gold Skulltulas that can be found in the Shadow Temple once you've claimed the Lenses of Truth from the Bottom of the Well, you'll need to advance through the dungeon until reaching the basement floor B4. Upon reaching the area with the large docked skeletal ship, there's a large cage with a block you can pull out for a shortcut back to floor B1. Atop the cage, look for a gust of straw and play the Scarecrow's Song to summon Pierre. You can hookshot to him, and find the Gold Skulltula on a nearby wall.

**Requires:** Lenses of Truth, Hover Boots, Scarecrow's Song
1063093:
**Location:** One of several Gold Skulltulas that can be found in the Shadow Temple once you've claimed the Lenses of Truth from the Bottom of the Well, you'll need to advance through the dungeon until reaching the basement floor B4. Ride the skeletal ship to the far western side of the dungeon, and then head through to a room full of invisible maze-like walls. Make your way to the far west room where three large spinning skulls are. Toss a bomb in each, and one will explode to reveal a Gold Skulltula inside.

**Requires:** Lenses of Truth, Hover Boots, Bombs
1063094:
**Location:** Once you've become Adult Link, there's a few Golden Skulltulas that will appear in Gerudo Valley. To reach it, you'll either need to gallop across the broken bridge with Epona, or gain access to the Longshot. However you do, look for the new carpenter's tent on the other side once it's nightfall, and you'll find some ruins behind it with a Gold Skulltula on the wall.

**Requires:** Longshot or Epona
1063095:
**Location:** Once you've become Adult Link, there's a few Golden Skulltulas that will appear in Gerudo Valley. To reach it, you'll either need to gallop across the broken bridge with Epona, or gain access to the Longshot. However you do, search the southern area opposite the carpenter's camp for a series of large rocks you can destroy with the Megaton Hammer. However, if you look upward on the inside of a natural stone arch, you'll find a Gold Skulltula here at night.

**Requires:** Longshot or Epona
1063096:
**Location:** The guarded fortress of the Gerudo hides several Gold Skulltulas, and while its possible to find a few while evading capture, it's easier to get the Gerudo on your side first. Once you do, look for a fortress entrance up on a high level in the northeast, adorned with red fabric. On a high wall to the right of the doorway you can find a Gold Skulltula at night.

**Requires:** Longshot
1063097:
**Location:** The guarded fortress of the Gerudo hides several Gold Skulltulas, and while its possible to find a few while evading capture, it's easier to get the Gerudo on your side first. Once you do, take Epona over to the horseback archery training course at night, and ride to the top northeast corner. Look around the back of the large target place high in the air, and you'll find a Gold Skulltula hiding here.

**Requires:** Longshot
1063098:
**Location:** Past the guarded Gerudo Fortress, you can find a Gold Skulltula all the way out in the middle of the Mirage Desert. You'll need to carefully cross the line of quicksand, and then follow the markers until you reach a ruin to take shelter in. Look for a ladder down away from the sands, and in a small chamber you can find the Gold Skulltula.

**Requires:** Longshot
1063099:
**Location:** After you've crossed the Mirage Desert past Gerudo Fortress, you'll arrive at the Evil Desert Colossus where the Spirit Temple is. Use the Sun's Song to turn day to night, then check the northern cliffs of this area where some Guay gather in flocks, and you can also find a Gold Skulltula along the walls.

**Requires:** Longshot
1063100:
**Location:** After you've crossed the Mirage Desert past Gerudo Fortress, you'll arrive at the Evil Desert Colossus where the Spirit Temple is. Once you try to enter as Adult Link, you'll find that only Child Link can fit in a tunnel, prompting Sheik to teach you the melody to warp here. Return as Child Link and bring some Magic Beans with you. There's a patch of soft soil just by the entrance you can plant the beans in. Return as Adult Link and once night has fallen, ride the magic floating plant to a large raised plateau in the northeast, where a Gold Skulltula is hiding out of view.

**Requires:** Magic Beans
1063101:
**Location:** Entering the Spirit Temple as Adult Link after you've solved the first part as Child Link, you can find a few Gold Skulltulas at this point in time. One can be found after opening the door from the entrance hall to the northeast, leading you to a half-pipe room filled with rolling boulders. Check along the left side past a blue block for an open alcove hiding a Gold Skulltula.

**Requires:** Silver Gauntlets
1063102:
**Location:** Entering the Spirit Temple as Adult Link after you've solved the first part as Child Link, you can find a few Gold Skulltulas at this point in time. One can be found after reaching the floor 3F where the large statue is sitting. Head along the western side of the room to spot a gust of air over in the upper left corner. Play the Scarecrow Song to summon Pierre, and hookshot over to locate a Gold Skulltula.

**Requires:** Silver Gauntlets, Longshot, Scarecrow's Song
1063103:
**Required:** Silver Gauntlets, Lenses of Truth

**Location:** Journey back to the Zora Fountain where Jabu-Jabu once was as an adult, and look near the Great Fairy's Fountain for a stack of obsidian rocks. Use the Silver Gauntlets to lift them out of the way to find a cave tunnel. You'll want the Lenses of Truth, as it's full of invisible Skulltulas that will block your path. Head all the way to the top, and turn around to find the Gold Skulltula.
1063104:
**Location:** On the road leading to Lon Lon Ranch, past the sign outside of Hyrule Castle Town.

Look for the purple lantern here, then jump over it on Epona to make the Big Poe appear.
1063105:
**Location:** On the bank of the western moat for Hyrule Castle Town.

Look for the purple lantern here, then jump over it on Epona to make the Big Poe appear.
1063106:
**Location:** On the dirt road, close to the entrance to Lon Lon Ranch.

Look for the purple lantern here, then jump over it on Epona to make the Big Poe appear.
1063107:
**Location:** Near the western wall of Lon Lon Ranch, lines up roughly with a water tower in the ranch.

Look for the purple lantern here, then jump over it on Epona to make the Big Poe appear.
1063108:
**Location:** In the desert-like valley before the entrance to Gerudo Valley. Close to where you'll find the locked chest Heart Piece.

Look for the purple lantern here, then jump over it on Epona to make the Big Poe appear.
1063109:
**Location:** On the border of the desert-like part of Hyrule Field and its grassland, close to the ruined tower in Lon Lon Ranch.

Look for the purple lantern here, then jump over it on Epona to make the Big Poe appear.
1063110:
**Location:** In the woods-like area south of Lon Lon Ranch.
